entities.name: Plant mitochondrial uS7m
observations: The 148-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana uS7m (UniProt P92557; 100% identity and coverage; E=1.61e-100).
Reference annotation: primary rRNA-binding protein directly binding 18S rRNA and nucleating small-subunit head assembly; mitochondrial localization.
Sequence-derived properties: 17,200.9 Da; theoretical pI 10.54; predicted charge at pH 7 +15.76.

entities.name: Mitochondrial translation
observations: Matched uS7m reference annotation associates the protein with ribosome structure, rRNA binding, and translation (GO:0006412).
